documented_requirement_or_status: Provides legal framework for designated marketplaces to collect deposit and report Article 22 income tax on domestic sellers' PMSE income
what_it_establishes: A legal participant-reporting and withholding architecture exists
what_it_does_not_establish: Actual implementation coverage data quality successful taxpayer matching or compliance effects

documented_requirement_or_status: Sellers provide NPWP or NIK and correspondence address plus applicable turnover or exemption declarations
what_it_establishes: The architecture is designed to connect seller identity and marketplace activity
what_it_does_not_establish: Whether identities are complete accurate deduplicated or linked to other statistical records

documented_requirement_or_status: Article 22 withholding rate is 0.5 percent of gross turnover stated in the invoice excluding VAT and luxury-goods sales tax
what_it_establishes: The policy uses transaction-linked gross turnover rather than platform corporate revenue as the seller-side base
what_it_does_not_establish: Tax liability ultimately due audit outcomes merchant compliance or treatment of nonmarketplace sales

documented_requirement_or_status: Four marketplaces were appointed as Article 22 collectors under the new framework
what_it_establishes: Named intermediaries were formally assigned a reporting and collection role
what_it_does_not_establish: Successful operation or comprehensive coverage of Indonesian e-commerce

documented_requirement_or_status: Application was postponed through 31 October 2026; the earlier appointment decisions were to be cancelled and reissued; amounts already withheld were to be returned
what_it_establishes: As of 10 September 2026 the legal architecture cannot yet be treated as an operating post-policy data system
what_it_does_not_establish: Any eventual implementation effect effectiveness coverage or compliance outcome
